# Roadmap

What may come next in Pointe, and how you can move it. Also on the site: https://eng.ballerine.com/pointe/roadmap/

## How it works

- **Vote** with a 👍 reaction on an item's issue. Each section below is sorted by 👍. A "+1" comment is not counted.
- **Propose** something new in [Discussions → Ideas](https://github.com/ballerine-io/pointe/discussions/categories/ideas). An idea that gathers support becomes a roadmap issue.
- **Triage.** The maintainers read new ideas and votes about once a week, and move items between Now, Next and Later with the labels `horizon/now`, `horizon/next` and `horizon/later`. Votes inform the order; they do not decide it alone.
- **No dates.** Pointe is community-supported, on a best-effort basis ([Support](README.md#support)).
- **Build one.** Items open to contributors say *good first issue* or *help wanted*. Start with [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), and comment on the issue before you start something large.

Votes as of 2026-11-21.
